evals.prompt: 发布一份 PRD 到钉钉。先用缺失版本表的文件验证无远端调用，再用有效 V1.2 文件发布并让线上回读返回不一致的 V1.1。只使用 fake/spy。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the missing version table before any DingTalk call and rejects a successful remote write whose latest version row does not match the local PRD.

assertions.text: Missing or invalid version history fails before dws auth and leaves the fake dws call log empty.
The publisher never invents or increments a PRD version.
Read-back compares the complete latest version row and fails when version, date, or change summary differs.

evals.prompt: 用这个 product-delivery-manifest.yaml 发布 Package，但 Human approval 里的 payload fingerprint 已经过期。不要真实发布，用 fake/spy 验证调用边界。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the stale approval before the first DingTalk call and leaves the Manifest unchanged.

assertions.text: Canonical validation fails before dws auth or any remote write.
The fake/spy dws call log remains empty.
The failed preflight does not mutate the Manifest.

evals.prompt: 这个 Package 的 Manifest 已写入 Human approval。现在从 Agent Runtime 真实发布到钉钉。用 fake/spy 验证授权边界。
evals.expected_output: Returns authorization_required because the current Agent Runtime has no trusted host approval capability, makes zero dws calls, and leaves the Manifest unchanged.

assertions.text: A self-contained Manifest approval is not accepted as trusted host authorization.
The fake/spy dws call log remains empty.

evals.prompt: 对已批准的 Product Delivery Package 做完整发布预检，但不要真实发布钉钉。
evals.expected_output: Validates the current Package verdict, approval, payload fingerprint, paths, hashes, and allowlist in dry-run mode with zero dws calls and no Manifest mutation.

assertions.text: Dry-run reaches the canonical Package preflight.
The fake/spy dws call log remains empty.

evals.prompt: 尝试在 Package mode 里用 --folder 覆盖 Manifest 目标，并把 content path 改成 ../outside.md。用 fake/spy 证明不会产生副作用。
evals.expected_output: Rejects CLI target overrides and path traversal before remote calls without changing review or approval records.

assertions.text: Both override and traversal cases make zero dws calls.
Absolute, traversal, missing, hash-mismatched, and escaping paths fail closed.
Publisher failure cannot rewrite review or approval partitions.
